desc:
Welcome to Jump To Steal An Egg! 🥚

How to Play:
✨ Jump and collect the Eggs that appear!
🥚 Bring them back to your base to hatch them!
🔋 Upgrade your jump power to jump even higher!
🏗️ Upgrade your base to get even more slots!
🐾 Collect amazing Creatures and Pets!

Remember to Like and Favorite the game for updates! 👍⭐
